Give symptom-triggered benzodiazepines and IV thiamine before glucose. Continue piperacillin-tazobactam for cholangitis.

Diagnosis: Takotsubo cardiomyopathy (stress cardiomyopathy), supported by apical ballooning, reduced LVEF, and absence of obstructive coronary artery disease or pulmonary embolism. Discontinue therapeutic anticoagulation as PE has been ruled out. Manage with standard heart failure therapy (e.g., ACE inhibitors, beta-blockers) and supportive care. Lower-extremity duplex ultrasound is no longer indicated as the primary diagnosis is not venous thromboembolism. Continue her asthma inhalers.
